label: Act, non-reception and thin profiles of the unde inference: controls
paraphrase: Closed finite profiles over two beings and three stand-in respects (being, a nature, wisdom); statements about them only. Act profile: R-dep, both unde bridges, the nature in act and 7de89edb hold, and so does R-act1. Non-reception profile, read with the act relation (esse actualizes the nature but is not received in it) and with the dependence relation: R-dep, the first bridge, the nature in act and 7de89edb hold; the second bridge and R-act1 fail; the essence-only account and finitude in perfection hold. Omitting the first bridge: R-act1 fails though the rest holds. Reception without the nature premise: R-act1, 7de89edb and the capacity bridge hold and finitude fails. For R-act2: with intensive inclusion it holds; with thin inclusion, or with no actualization recorded, it fails while R-dep, the first bridge where present and the witness premise hold. Neither the extensions nor the Lean types tell the act relation from the dependence relation: both senses have type B → R → R → Prop, so bind-check does not enforce the distinction; only the definition records state it.
